info.name: GCM Portal
info.description: GCM Portal API + Platform (Super Admin) collection. Covers everything shipped through Phase 1 .

request.description: Postman is never a SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS origin, so this always returns a bearer `token` (the same path a future mobile app would use) instead of a session cookie. The test script below saves it into {{tenant_token}}, which every other request in this collection sends via the collection-level Bearer auth.
In local dev, MAIL_MAILER=log — grab the reset token from storage/logs/laravel.log.

item.name: 9. Services
item.description: FRD V01.14 §1.9 — main services (a category: non_hazardous | hazardous | supplying, with its supported vehicle categories) and sub-services (asset type, compatible capacities, intermediate facilities, recycle-receipt flag, skip colour). System Admin / Data Entry manage; Auditor views/exports; Driver 403. JSON bodies (no files). No delete routes — deactivate instead.

request.description: search matches the main service name AND its sub-services' names (both columns are on screen). service_type: non_hazardous | hazardous | supplying. operational_status: active | deactivated. sort_by: name | service_type | operational_status | created_at. Each row carries sub_services [{id,name,operational_status,asset_type,requires_recycle_receipt,skip_color_code,skip_color_label,skip_color_hex}] and vehicle_categories. The Sub Services accordion page uses this endpoint with per_page/page (10 mains per page by default) + the same search/service_type/operational_status filters. subs_limit=N (max 50) returns only the first N sub-services of each row plus the true sub_services_count (omit it to get all of them); subs_match=1 together with search narrows both to the matching sub-services unless the main service itself matched. search_in = all (default) | main (the main service name only) | sub (its sub-services' names only) limits what search looks at.
vehicle_category_ids: at least one, from GET /vehicle-categories (tenant-scoped ids). service_type is locked after creation. operational_status: active | deactivated.

Includes vehicle_categories, sub_services, in_use (true once a PO includes it — always false until POs exist), stats (zeros until trips/POs exist) and meta.embedded_capacities: the embedded containers of vehicles in the supported categories (shown as information on the sub-service form).

FRD §1.9.1: name + additional_data only. service_type, vehicle_category_ids and operational_status are fixed at creation / have their own endpoint — they are ignored here. 422 when the service is in a PO.
status: active | deactivated. Deactivating also deactivates every sub-service under it; reactivating does NOT reactivate them. 422 when the service is in a PO.

main_service_id must be ACTIVE and is locked after creation. capacity_ids (GET /asset-capacity-categories) must fit asset_type (applies_to container/tank/both). facility_ids: active facilities, required unless the main service is `supplying`. skip_color_code (optional): designated_yard | white_paper | brown_cardboard | light_blue_wood | gray_plastic | red_metal_scrap | black_hazardous | green_general | yellow_food | light_concrete | green_glass.
Includes main_service (with its vehicle_categories — inherited), capacities, facilities, locked (ongoing trip / main in a PO — always false until trips/POs exist), stats (zeros).

FRD §1.9.2: name + skip_color_code + additional_data only (an omitted field keeps its value). main_service_id, asset_type, capacity_ids, facility_ids, requires_recycle_receipt and operational_status are ignored here. 422 when locked.
status: active | deactivated. Reactivating is refused (422) while the main service is deactivated; deactivating is refused while locked.

item.name: 10. Contractors
item.description: Phase 2 · Part 3 — FRD V01.14 §1.10. system_admin / data_entry create, edit and (de)activate; auditor views and exports; driver has no access. No hard delete. The contractor ID is the short name + "C" + a running number (e.g. ALN-C0001), so it never clashes with a client company ID. Deactivating a contractor does not touch its drivers / vehicles / assets. A driver, vehicle or asset belongs to a contractor through affiliation=contractor + contractor_id (see those folders).

item.description: FRD V01.14 §1.12 — client projects, plus inserting an asset into a project (§1.7.3). system_admin / data_entry manage; auditor views and exports; driver has no access.

request.description: system_admin / data_entry / auditor (ProjectPolicy::viewAny). Genuinely paginated server-side. `company_id` also feeds the projects section of a company page.

name + company_id + operational_status are required. company_id must be one of the tenant's ACTIVE client companies. The project ID (code) is generated: the company short name + "P" + a running number per company, e.g. ALN-P0001. The company cannot be changed after creation. location_url is http/https only. Optional "representative_id": an active client account that can see the project (on create: the company's all-projects accounts only).
Returns the project with its company block and the placeholder stats (contracts / trips / waste are 0 until those modules exist).

Every field is editable except the company (locked — the project ID is built from it) and the status (own endpoint). A company_id in the payload is ignored. Optional "representative_id": an active client account that can see the project (on create: the company's all-projects accounts only).
status: active | deactivated. system_admin / data_entry. Nothing cascades: not to the company, not to the assets already in the project. A deactivated project cannot receive new assets.

FRD §1.7.3 "Insert an asset into a project". system_admin / data_entry (403 otherwise). 201 returns the asset with availability "in_project" and its project. 422 when the asset is not available (in maintenance / deactivated / already in a project — error on asset_id) or the project is deactivated (error on project). 404 for a project of another tenant. There is no endpoint to take an asset back out (not defined by the FRD yet).
The project details page's assets table — the normal assets list filtered by project_id.
